theorems.name: Submission.c1approx_lusin_closed_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn n)) (ν : Rn n → Rn m), MeasurableSet S → Measurable ν → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C ⊆ S, IsClosed C ∧ ContinuousOn ν C ∧ volume (S \ C) < ENNReal.ofReal ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
